title: HEROES, VILLAINS, AND VICTIMS, AND GPT-3 AUTOMATED EXTRACTION OF CHARACTER ROLES WITHOUT TRAINING DATA
reasoning: The paper focuses on narrative character role extraction (hero, villain, victim) using GPT-3 and benchmarks its performance. While it discusses character archetypes and partisan framing bias in political speeches, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral systems, or ethical frameworks. Mentions of bias in the 'Limitations' section do not qualify it as faith/ethics related.
